# Car Castle Goa - Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Rental Catalog (llms-full.txt)

## Entity Identity
- Entity: Car Castle Rentals Goa
- Industry: Automotive / Self-Drive Vehicle Rental
- Region: State of Goa, Republic of India
- Contact Phone / WhatsApp: +91 87672 86682
- Official Web: https://carcastlegoa.com
- Customer Support: 24/7 round-the-clock availability across North & South Goa

## Service Philosophy & Differentiators
1. Transparent Pricing: Guaranteed zero hidden charges, zero surprise cleanup fees, and zero return deductions.
2. Verified Sanitized Fleet: Each vehicle undergoes multi-point mechanical inspection, pressure-cleaning, and sanitization prior to delivery.
3. Rapid Minimal Documentation: Fast paperwork process requiring only an original Driving License and Aadhaar/Passport.
4. Comprehensive Airport Meet & Greet: Handover right outside arrival terminals at Dabolim (GOI) and Mopa (GOX) with real-time flight tracking.

## Terms, Policies & Legal Details
- Driving License Requirements: Indian permanent driving license (LLR not accepted) or valid International Driving Permit (IDP) alongside foreign passport.
- Security Deposit: Transparent, fully refundable upon handover.
- Fuel Policy: Level-to-level (take at 50%, return at 50%).
- Speed Limits: Goa state highway speed limit is strictly enforced via speed cameras at 80 km/h (city zones: 40-50 km/h).
- Geographic Boundary: Vehicles are registered with yellow-board commercial self-drive permits strictly for operation inside Goa state. Interstate travel requires prior authorization and temporary state tax payment.
